upstream_owner_summary.warning: The selected pool is a biased completeness subset. Do not extrapolate its composition to Sri Lankan EV owners.

policy.frequency: One feasible weekly rate per owner; daily Poisson candidate counts with mean rate/7.
policy.context_rates: Allocate sampled total across context bounds in proportion to available widths.
policy.start_windows: Uniform reported clock window; wrap midnight; no extra TOU delay or weekday effect.
policy.energy: Independent usual-energy draw per candidate; no separate distance-derived energy added.
policy.power: Use existing power helper once per session; constant effective average power.
policy.overlap: Sort by start time per owner; reject overlapping candidates without shifting or replacing them.
policy.rates_after_rejection: Realized accepted frequency can be below proposed Poisson frequency; inspect rejections.
policy.warmup: Longest possible session duration rounded to days plus one day; empty initial state, not proven stationarity.
policy.boundary: Count warm-up carry-in and study-start carry-out explicitly; hourly CSV covers study only.
policy.electricity: Delivered-energy load proxy; grid conversion losses and auxiliary loads are not modelled.

limitations: Single seed engineering run, not repeated Monte Carlo uncertainty or a national forecast.
Completeness-selected synthetic owners; no empirical calibration or population weighting.
No trip/SOC state, usable battery-capacity constraints, vehicle acceptance curves or connector matching.
Rejected candidate energy is hypothetical; it is not measured unserved charging demand.
No station assignment, port/site capacity, queues, travel time or public/private access enforcement.
